anomalies.description: A man in a dark, confined space is seen gripping another man's jaw/face with his hand while the second man lies helpless on the ground; the aggressor appears to be shouting or screaming into the victim's face, indicating a violent assault on a non-resisting individual.

The two individuals engage in close physical struggle: the aggressor’s grip shifts, the victim’s arm moves upward, and there is visible tension and motion suggesting mutual resistance during the restraint.; Initial physical struggle in dim lighting; two individuals are in close contact with dynamic movement suggesting mutual combat before one appears subdued.

After initial struggle, the aggressor continues to dominate the victim, who remains largely immobilized; frames show the aggressor leaning heavily over the victim in dim lighting, consistent with ongoing coercive control.; A person is seen lying on the ground while another individual leans over and applies force to their neck/throat area, consistent with choking or strangulation of a helpless victim.
A man is shown biting into the neck of another person, with visible blood appearing and increasing across frames, indicating a violent attack on a helpless victim.
In a damaged interior, one man is kneeling over another who is lying on the floor; the standing man appears to be restraining or assaulting the prone individual, suggesting active physical combat.

A man in a military-style jacket is seen kneeling over two prone, motionless individuals on the floor in a damaged interior; he appears to be checking or assaulting them, with visible blood and signs of injury on the victims.

A man in a military-style uniform is kneeling over a prone, injured man on the floor and repeatedly stabbing him with a knife; the victim is motionless and appears helpless, with visible blood pooling and on the attacker's hands and weapon.
A man in a green uniform is repeatedly stabbing a prone, motionless victim with a knife in a dim, damaged interior; the victim shows no resistance and appears helpless.

A person is lying on their back, mouth open in apparent distress or pain, while another individual looms over them holding a dark object (possibly a weapon or tool) near their face/throat in a threatening manner. The victim appears helpless and restrained.

A man in close-up shows intense facial strain, clenched jaw, and gripping hands; his expression and posture suggest active physical struggle or confrontation. Though the other party is not fully visible, the context from prior frames and his exertion indicate ongoing mutual combat.
A person is lying supine and appears helpless while another individual looms over them, holding a knife near their neck/throat in a threatening manner across the entire sequence.

A man in military-style uniform is kneeling over a prone, injured man on the ground, holding his jaw/neck area with force while leaning in closely; the prone man appears helpless and distressed, with visible blood on his neck/chest. The attacker’s posture and grip indicate deliberate, non-consensual physical control consistent with abuse rather than mutual combat.
